contentPattern: 1 row, 1 cell: image, h1, paragraph(s). The breadcrumb is not authored: it is built from the URL path (current page label from the optional 'breadcrumb-title' page metadata, otherwise the last path segment). Option 'dropdown' (care-type selector): add a second row with an optional label paragraph (e.g. 'Choose a condition to get tailored information.') and a bulleted list; one list item without a link is the button text (e.g. 'Select a condition'), every list item with a link is a selector option. If the list stays in the first cell it still works, without a visible label. Option 'announcement' (link strip under the banner image): add a paragraph containing only the link (e.g. 'Introducing savings on 30+ Pfizer brands for eligible patients.') right after the image, before the h1; it renders as a full-width strip between the image and the text panel. Without the option class the paragraph renders as normal content. To hide the auto breadcrumb on a page, set page metadata 'Breadcrumb' to 'off'.

options.label: Announcement (link strip under the banner image)
